name: Pac-Man
summary: The arcade original, ghosts and all.
description:
Pac-Man for the CE. Eat the pellets, avoid Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde, and the big flashing pellets turn that round for a while. Fruit shows up now and then.

Arrows move, [2nd] or [enter] continues, and [del] pauses and quits. Pressing [5] on the title screen turns on hacked mode, which is a second set of maps.

Unlike most of this store, it needs no C libraries: it is eZ80 assembly and runs on a calculator with nothing else on it.

Pac-Man is a trademark of Bandai Namco. This is a fan reimplementation and is not affiliated with them.
author: Matt "MateoConLechuga" Waltz
